data.name: ProductName
data.comment: The product name. Not translated, kept here so it appears once.

data.name: WindowTitle
data.comment: 0 = product name, 1 = week label, 2 = draft or published state.

data.name: WeekBeginning
data.comment: 0 = the Monday the roster week starts on.

data.name: Starting
data.comment: Shown before the first load finishes.

data.name: GenerateRoster
data.comment: Toolbar button.

data.name: Print
data.comment: Toolbar button.

data.name: Working
data.comment: Shown beside the toolbar while a long action runs.

data.name: NoRosterStored
data.value: No roster stored for the week beginning {0:d MMMM yyyy}.
data.comment: 0 = week start date.

data.name: NothingToDrawYet
data.value: Importing a sheet and generating a roster arrive in the next change. This screen draws what is already stored.
data.comment: First run guidance.

data.name: CouldNotLoad
data.value: Could not load the roster. See the log for details.
data.comment: Shown instead of a stack trace.

data.name: CouldNotGenerate
data.value: Could not generate the roster. See the log for details.
data.comment: Shown instead of a stack trace.

data.name: CouldNotPrint
data.value: Could not print the roster. See the log for details.
data.comment: Shown instead of a stack trace.

data.name: NothingToPrint
data.comment: Print pressed with no stored roster.

data.name: SentToPrinter
data.comment: Print handed the document to the platform.

data.name: StatusDraft
data.comment: Roster state, shown in the title bar and status bar.

data.name: StatusPublished
data.comment: 0 = version number. A published roster is on a wall somewhere.

data.name: Counts
data.comment: 0 = placed, 1 = unplaced, 2 = overtime, 3 = off. Counted per person per day.

data.name: NoWarnings
data.comment: Warnings summary when there are none.

data.name: ErrorCountOne
data.comment: Warnings summary.

data.name: ErrorCountMany
data.comment: 0 = count. Warnings summary.

data.name: NoticeCountOne
data.comment: Warnings summary.

data.name: NoticeCountMany
data.comment: 0 = count. Warnings summary.

data.name: WarningsSummary
data.comment: 0 = the errors phrase, 1 = the notices phrase.

data.name: SeverityError
data.comment: Warning severity. The word carries the meaning; styling only makes it findable.

data.name: SeverityNotice
data.comment: Warning severity.

data.name: ContextSeparator
data.comment: Between the date and the line name on a warning.

data.name: RoleLeader
data.comment: One of the three ways a line leader is marked, alongside weight and a filled block.

data.name: ChipEdited
data.comment: Marks an assignment placed by hand rather than by the engine.

data.name: Headcount
data.comment: 0 = assigned, 1 = required. Always both numbers, so short needs no arithmetic.

data.name: LineNeeds
data.comment: 0 = required headcount, on the row header.

data.name: LineShortOneDay
data.comment: Row header summary.

data.name: LineShortManyDays
data.comment: 0 = number of days. Row header summary.

data.name: UnknownEmployee
data.comment: An identifier with no employee behind it. Should never appear; saying so beats a blank chip that looks like a rendering fault.

data.name: Lines
data.comment: Title of the line setup screen.

data.name: SetUpLines
data.comment: Toolbar button opening line setup.

data.name: LineName
data.comment: Watermark on the new line box.

data.name: AddLine
data.comment: Button.

data.name: SaveLines
data.comment: Button.

data.name: LineAdded
data.comment: 0 = line name.

data.name: LinesSavedOne
data.comment: Confirmation.

data.name: LinesSavedMany
data.comment: 0 = count.

data.name: NoLinesYet
data.value: No production lines yet. A roster needs at least one line to put people on.
data.comment: Empty state on the line setup screen.

data.name: HeadcountNeeded
data.comment: Column header on the line setup screen.

data.name: DisplayOrder
data.comment: Column header. The order lines appear in on screen and on the printed sheet.

data.name: Close
data.comment: Button.
